rules.statement: A letter of acknowledgment can be used to avoid prescription only if it is accompanied by a promise and signed by the party chargeable or an authorized agent, as per section 13 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871.
rules.supporting_quote: "no acknowledgment by words only shall be deemed evidence of a new or continuing contract, whereby to take the case out of the operation of the enactments contained in the said section, or any of them, or to deprive any party of the benefit thereof, unless such acknowledgment shall be made or contained in some writing to be signed by the party chargeable or by some agent duly authorized to enter into such contract on his behalf"
